candidates.title: Plant efficiency: a sensitivity analysis of the capacity factor for fusion power plants with high recirculated power
candidates.notes: Peer-reviewed (Nuclear Fusion Vol. 61, 2021). Directly addresses capacity factor and its interaction with recirculated power fraction — the central challenge for NBI-heavy beam-driven fusion like TAE's Da Vinci. Not FRC-specific but directly applicable by analogy. Analyzes Power Plant Conceptual Study models. Argues first-generation plants will combine high recirculating power with low capacity factor, resulting in poor plant efficiency.

candidates.title: The Princeton Field-Reversed Configuration for Compact Nuclear Fusion Power Plants
candidates.notes: Princeton FRC paper covers D-He3 fuel at 1-10 MW scale (not p-B11, not Da Vinci scale). Steady-state FRC design but no capacity factor data in abstract. Deprioritized.

candidates.title: TAE shortens device roadmap, prepares for commercial era
candidates.notes: TAE's own press release — likely JS-heavy landing page with no quantitative capacity factor data. Deprioritized given no TAE availability claims appear anywhere in public record.

entries.notes: No TAE-specific capacity factor data found anywhere in public record. Extracted a peer-reviewed analogy source (Mulder et al. 2021) that directly models the capacity factor penalty for fusion plants with high recirculated power fraction — the core issue for Da Vinci's NBI-driven design. This provides an analytical framework for estimating capacity factor impact, but does not provide a TAE-stated target.

candidates.title: Enhanced plasma performance in C-2W advanced beam-driven field-reversed configuration experiments (Gota et al. 2024, Nuclear Fusion 64 112014)
candidates.notes: Open-access peer-reviewed paper reporting most recent C-2W/Norman performance. PDF extracted successfully. Contains quantitative plasma parameters and confinement duration data (30 ms pulse limited by NBI pulse duration). Directly addresses FRC CW operation status.

candidates.title: Methodology for Scaling Fusion Power Plant Availability (Waganer 2011, PPPL Report 4585)
candidates.notes: PPPL technical report establishing methodology for estimating availability of first-of-a-kind vs. tenth-of-a-kind fusion plants. PDF extracted successfully. Directly addresses the capacity factor estimation problem for early fusion plants like Da Vinci.

candidates.title: Generation of field-reversed configurations via neutral beam injection (Roche et al. 2025, Nature Communications)
candidates.notes: Open-access peer-reviewed paper reporting NBI-only FRC formation on TAE's Norm device. Already cited as external reference in analysis (source #9) but not previously extracted. Establishes formation within ~10 ms, relevant to understanding pulse structure and path to CW operation.
